blocks.text: Shuvee Etrata marked another career milestone as she took on her first-ever international film, a Japanese family drama. Sparkle GMA Artist Center gave a glimpse of the Kapuso actress and her Filipino co-stars Mon Confiado and Radson Flores during the film shooting, through its Instagram page on Thursday, Nov. 26. In one of the photos, Etrata can be seen wearing a Japanese kimono. The film is directed by Japanese actor-director Takashi Yuki and produced by Kuruwa LLC. Further details about the project have yet to be announced. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sparkle GMA Artist Center (@sparklegmaartistcenter) […]...
